fields.value: Fast ventricular timing with a conditional mean-interval estimate near 159 bpm; most intervals are similar, but the second is shorter. Repeated pointed intercomplex waves and a changing baseline surround the sharp positive-negative complexes. Those waves are not assigned a single atrial identity or sequence. Numeric PR remains held, and neither fixed 2:1 conduction, the shorter-interval mechanism nor a QRS-width class is established.
